title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 11, section 3 (Keats Island)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 11 Prohibited Discharge Areas — Rifles (Section 10 (1) (c))
Keats Island
3 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U. 2-16 that is all of Keats Island together with the adjacent foreshore between the natural boundary of Keats Island and the mean low water mark. [en. B.C. Reg. 204/91, s. 14.]
